local p = {}


function p.loli()
	
local PlaceId = 8304191830
local ApiUrl = "https://api.roblox.com"

local function getRequest(url)
    local tempFileName = "tempfile.txt"
    local cmd = "curl -s -o " .. tempFileName .. " " .. url
    os.execute(cmd)

    local file = io.open(tempFileName, "r")
    local response = file:read("*a")
    file:close()

    os.remove(tempFileName)

    return response
end

local function getPlaceInfo(placeId)
    local apiUrl = ApiUrl .. "/games/" .. tostring(placeId)
    local response = getRequest(apiUrl)

    if response then
        local json = require("json") -- You'll need to provide a JSON library if not available by default
        local placeInfo = json.decode(response)
        return placeInfo
    end

    return nil
end

-- Example usage:
local placeId = 8304191830
local placeInfo = getPlaceInfo(placeId)
if placeInfo then
    return "Place Name: " .. placeInfo.Name .. "\nCreator Name: " .. placeInfo.Creator.Name .. "\nVisits: " .. placeInfo.Visits
else
    return "Failed to fetch place information."
end




end

return p
